Read on with `seed_show` with {"seed": "<id>", "since": <N>} or `seed_show` with {"seed": "<id>", "since": 12}, and search with `seed_search` with {"query": "two words", "limit": <n>}. `"lines": <n>` picks the last lines of `terminal_read` with {"terminal": "<terminal>"}.

    seed_show {"seed": "<id>", "since": <N>}   only what was saved after bookmark N

Skip what you have read with `seed_show` with {"seed": "<id>", "since": …}.
